name: switch
title: Switch
description: Turns a setting on or off immediately, with its label on the inline-end side and optional help text.

examples.name: switch-settings
examples.title: Settings list
examples.description: Label plus description, linked with aria-describedby.

props.name: children
props.description: The label. Without one, pass aria-label.

props.name: description
props.description: Help text under the label, linked with aria-describedby.

notes: Uses a native checkbox with role switch; the on/off state is announced.
State shows by thumb position and track fill, not colour alone; the off track (border.strong) meets 3:1 against the surface.
The thumb moves toward the inline end, so it mirrors in right-to-left layouts.
Rows are at least 24px tall and the label is part of the target.

do: Use for settings that take effect immediately.
Label the setting, not the state: "Payment alerts", not "On".
dont: Don't use a switch in a form that needs a Submit button; use a Checkbox.
Don't change the label text when toggling.
